DRAKENSTEIN MUNICIPALITY (Paarl, WC) - Telkom account [number removed], stand 100/007/[number removed]/00000/0000/0000, LOCATION HOOFSTRAAT 145.

PAGE STRUCTURE (all 9 bills identical): exactly 2 PDF pages, ONE '\f' break. Page 1 = masthead + ACCOUNT SUMMARY + payment boilerplate (~6.0k chars). Page 2 = ACCOUNT DETAILS: the per-service charge table (~1.0k chars). Total raw text 7.0-7.1k chars. There is NO reverse-side terms-and-conditions page and NO newsletter insert, so the Breede Valley whitespace-soup problem does NOT occur here (BV page 2 alone was ~176k chars). PDF byte size (0.92MB - 4.22MB) is entirely embedded raster artwork (masthead logo, QR code, 'Pay Now' button) and varies with image compression only - it has no relation to text volume. No page is a scanned image: every page has a real text layer, read_pdf reports ocr:False scanned:False on all 9, so no OCR is used and no row is OCR-flagged.

Every bill opens with a mailer/route wrapper line: '<![number removed]|[address removed]|true|24|07|2026|1|2|...!>' repeated at the top of each page. That is the e-delivery envelope, NOT bill data, and the CBRE/Excellerate recipient address in it appears on 13 different municipalities' folders in this tree - it is deliberately NOT part of the fingerprint (that mistake is what makes shipped 'mangaung' hijack other municipalities).

FINGERPRINT: '4500109717' is DRAKENSTEIN'S OWN VAT registration, printed 'VAT REG NO: 4500109717' in the masthead. Scanned over all 219 PDFs in /mnt/user-data/uploads/Telkom: present in the 9 Drakenstein bills and nowhere else. '4680101146' printed two lines lower is labelled 'CUSTOMER VAT REG NUMBER' - it is TELKOM's (the customer's) VAT number and appears in 16 different folders; it must never be fingerprinted on. The 'any' markers (DRAKENSTEIN, drakenstein.gov.za, Drakenstein.cabedocs.com, 'Bank approved beneficiary: Drakenstein Billing') were each verified unique to this folder too.

SECTIONS: 'rates' is a RULES-FREE BOUNDARY at '^ ASSESSMENT RATES$'. Drakenstein prints that heading with only a STAND line under it and no charge line at all on these accounts, so it must produce no row; as the first section start it also pins header = page 1 + the page-2 ACCOUNT DETAILS strapline, which is where all the account-level meta lives. 'electricity' starts at 'ELECTRICITY (PERIOD ...)' and runs to end of text - only ~250 chars of totals follow, all of it wanted (SERVICE TOTAL PAYABLE, CURRENT MONTH ACCOUNT TOTAL, VAT AMOUNT). No rule uses 'document' scope. Water / sewerage / refuse / assessment-rates charge lines never appear on these bills; if a future Drakenstein bill grows them they will land in their own sections and cannot reach an electricity column, because every electricity pattern is line-anchored inside section:electricity.

CHARGE TABLE (one line, one meter, on every bill):
  TARIFF  METER NO   PREVIOUS  CURRENT  (A)ctual/(I)nterim  FACTOR  TYPE  UNITS  AMOUNT  BASIC  PAYABLE
  ECS20   [number removed]   8959.000  9467.000  A                  1.00000 ME01  508.000 R 2 406.03 R 0.00 R 2 406.03
Tariff ECS20 / meter type ME01 is a FLAT single-rate energy tariff - no TOU bands, no demand, no NMD. Following the CoJ-flat / Ekurhuleni / Breede Valley convention the single band routes to STANDARD; peak/off-peak/demand/NMD are '_none'. Money uses SPACE thousands separators and a leading '-R' for credits ('-R 13 870.40'); _to_decimal handles both.

VAT BASIS - the important trap. Every Rand figure in the charge table and in the ACCOUNT SUMMARY is VAT-INCLUSIVE. The bill prints '*VAT AMOUNT @15% INCLUSIVE  R 313.83' and 2406.03 x 15/115 = 313.83 exactly (verified on all 9 bills; the VAT-exclusive reading 2406.03 x 0.15 = 360.90 matches none of them). So the ex-VAT canonical Rand columns are DERIVED by subtracting the printed VAT: standard_r = AMOUNT - VAT, total_ex_vat_r = CURRENT MONTH ACCOUNT TOTAL - VAT. Those are two DIFFERENT printed figures on two different lines, so reconcile here is not the usual circular sum-of-own-parts: it tests AMOUNT + BASIC == CURRENT MONTH ACCOUNT TOTAL (the VAT term cancels), and a silently-missed AMOUNT capture makes it fail by the whole bill instead of hiding in Other. CAVEAT stated plainly: BASIC is R 0.00 on all 9 bills, so other_r carries the basic charge as printed (0.00, where inc-VAT and ex-VAT are the same number). If Drakenstein ever bills a non-zero BASIC, other_r would be inc-VAT and standard_r would absorb the basic's VAT share; recalibrate then.

READING TYPE: the flag column is '(A)ctual/(I)nterim', not Actual/Estimated. All 9 bills print 'A'. reading_type is set by label_present from two mutually exclusive flag rules so an 'I' bill yields 'Interim' - the bill's own word - rather than relying on TRANSLATE (which knows 'a'->Actual and 'e'->Estimated but has no entry for 'i').

MISNAMED FILE: 'OUD_[number removed]_[number removed]-[number removed]-49665.pdf' carries the Oudtshoorn 'OUD_' filename prefix but is a Drakenstein bill - its text has PO BOX 12 / PAARL / 7622, [address removed], VAT REG NO 4500109717, account [number removed], and its meter readings (4572.000 -> 5020.000) slot exactly between the Oct-2025 and Jan-2026 bills in the single unbroken [number removed] reading chain. The genuine Oudtshoorn bill in this tree is account [number removed] with a completely different layout (PRIVATE BAG X137, no VAT REG NO line). Filename is a filing error; the fingerprint was not bent to accommodate it.

NEVER PRINTED by Drakenstein: TOU bands, demand kVA, notified maximum demand, a tariff NAME (only the code ECS20), a suburb/town for the site, any ex-VAT charge figure, cash/guarantee securities. HANDOVER AMOUNT, RECEIPT/JOURNAL CORRECTIONS and REFUNDS print a bare '-' on all 9 bills (zero), so their money rules correctly miss and stay blank.

fields.label: CUSTOMER VAT reg number (Telkom's, NOT the municipality's)
Less payments (blank when the bill prints a bare '-')
Tariff code / meter no / meter type (own rule - no collect, text)
UNITS kWh / AMOUNT / BASIC / PAYABLE (all VAT INCLUSIVE, summed if the tariff changes mid-period)

computes.label: Current reading - previous reading (independent kWh check)
Energy charge EX VAT = printed AMOUNT (inc VAT) - printed VAT
Electricity EX VAT = printed CURRENT MONTH ACCOUNT TOTAL - printed VAT
AMOUNT + BASIC (must equal the printed PAYABLE column)
SERVICE TOTAL PAYABLE - CURRENT MONTH ACCOUNT TOTAL (0.00 while electricity is the only service billed)
Page-1 CURRENT ACCOUNT - page-2 CURRENT MONTH ACCOUNT TOTAL (cross-page check, 0.00)
